vectorcombat.configuration.title: Vector Combat
vectorcombat.configuration.display.toolt: What you see: the arrow, trails, third-person swings, hands and shield motion.
vectorcombat.configuration.display.lineT: The dust line a charging mob draws before it charges. Off hides it.
vectorcombat.configuration.display.ringT: The dust ring that marks where a leaping mob will land. Off hides it.
vectorcombat.configuration.display.direc: A small arrow by the crosshair showing the way you moved on your last attack.
vectorcombat.configuration.display.first: Showcase carries the weapon broadside across the view; Classic plays the earlier clips.
vectorcombat.configuration.display.trail: Custom follows the blade through the swing; Vanilla is Minecraft's sweep crescent.
How solid the custom trail is, from invisible to fully solid.
vectorcombat.configuration.display.third: Arm, chest and legs follow the swing, in F5 and on other players. Off is vanilla's.
REFRESHED is the new third person; CLASSIC is exactly as it was before it.
Draw a crosshair in vanilla's F5, which has none (Shoulder Surfing has its own).
Swings in F5 turn to the foe nearest the crosshair: LIGHT 20 degrees, STRONG 35, OFF none.
vectorcombat.configuration.display.hands: Draw your arm holding items. Off is vanilla's look; also off while Punchy or similar is installed.
vectorcombat.configuration.display.shiel: The shield lifts, drops, snaps on a parry and recoils on a block. Off is vanilla's instant switch.
vectorcombat.configuration.display.fitHe: Weapons held at another angle than a sword swing along the same path. Off plays the clips as made.
vectorcombat.configuration.feel.impact.t: How hard hits shake the camera, hand and mob. 0 is none, 2 doubles it.
vectorcombat.configuration.feel.holdToAt: Holding the attack key swings again as soon as the weapon has recharged.
vectorcombat.configuration.feel.swingThr: A swing at a mob behind grass or flowers hits the mob, not the plant.
vectorcombat.configuration.feel.holdRech: How recharged the weapon must be before a held key swings again. 1 is full.
vectorcombat.configuration.feel.alternat: The standing slash alternates forehand and backhand. Off is always the forehand.
vectorcombat.configuration.feel.cooldown: Keep vanilla lowering the weapon while it recharges. Off keeps swings where authored.
vectorcombat.configuration.debug.tooltip: A log of what the mod does, to attach to a bug report.
vectorcombat.configuration.debug.debugLo: Write logs/vectorcombat-diag.jsonl for bug reports. Off: nothing is written.
vectorcombat.configuration.hitstop.toolt: A landed hit pauses the swing and the mob for a few ticks.
vectorcombat.configuration.hitstop.enabl: Landed hits pause the swing and the mob briefly, heavier weapons longer.
vectorcombat.configuration.hitstop.scale: Multiplies the pause. 0 is none, 1 the default, 2 doubles it.
vectorcombat.configuration.hitstop.maxTi: The longest pause in ticks (20 is one second).
vectorcombat.configuration.hitfx.tooltip: The contact sound and sparks of a landed hit.
Loudness of a landed hit. 0 is silent, 1 the default.
vectorcombat.configuration.hitfx.particl: Sparks flying from a landed hit.
How many sparks. 0 is none, 1 the default, 2 doubles them.
vectorcombat.configuration.penalty.toolt: How attacking, and repeating one attack, slows the next.
vectorcombat.configuration.penalty.refer: Penalty windows are seconds at this weapon speed and stretch for slower ones. 0 is plain seconds.
vectorcombat.configuration.penalty.fatig: What every hit in a steady stream adds to the penalty, whatever the attack. 0 is off.
vectorcombat.configuration.penalty.misse: A swing that hits nothing slows the next one as a hit does.
vectorcombat.configuration.penalty.maxSt: At most this many hits stack the attack-speed penalty. 0 is no cap.
vectorcombat.configuration.penalty.clear: A kill clears the attack-speed penalty at once.
vectorcombat.configuration.penalty.loris: With Loris Energy, light weapons cost less stamina per swing, heavy ones more.
vectorcombat.configuration.guard.tooltip: Parry rules: raise the shield just before a hit lands.
vectorcombat.configuration.guard.mode.to: AUTO: on unless Shield Expansion runs its own parry (not item only mode). ON always, OFF never.
vectorcombat.configuration.guard.parryTi: Ticks after a raise in which a hit is a parry (20 is one second). Vanilla blocks nothing for 5.
vectorcombat.configuration.guard.rearmTi: Ticks the shield must be down before a raise opens a parry window. 0 is no limit.
vectorcombat.configuration.guard.stagger: Seconds a parried attacker is stunned before the hit's damage adds to it.
Extra seconds of stagger per point of damage the parried hit would have done.
A parry refunds your weapon's attack cooldown.
vectorcombat.configuration.guard.guardBr: Heavy hits break a held guard (still blocked, then down a while).
A mob breaking your guard also stuns you. Off: your guard only drops.
vectorcombat.configuration.guard.deflect: Swings knock projectiles away; a well-timed one sends them back.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobGuard.tool: Mobs with a shield or a blocking weapon parry and block your hits.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobGuard.enab: Mobs with a shield or blocking weapon parry and block by your rules. Off: vanilla's shield only.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobGuard.weap: Share of a hit a mob's blocking weapon stops after the parry window (1 is all).
vectorcombat.configuration.mobGuard.disa: Ticks an axe hit knocks a mob's guard down for. 0 is never.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobGuard.reac: Mobs facing you may parry or block your swing, by the mob_guard data's odds.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobGuard.parr: Seconds you cannot swing after a mob parries your hit.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobGuard.ripo: A mob that parries you attacks again at once instead of waiting out its cooldown.
Ticks after a mob's parry before its riposte starts (20 is one second).
Melee mobs rear back before each hit and miss if you step out of reach; spiders pounce.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.weaponPa: A mob's hit runs its weapon's on-hit effects, as yours does, without wearing it.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.arming.t: Empty-handed mobs sometimes spawn with a weapon. AUTO leaves it to Jaam's Weaponry when installed.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.attackTo: Most mobs winding up at you at the same time; the rest wait. 0 is no limit.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.circling: Mobs waiting their turn circle you and feint.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.circleRa: Blocks from you that waiting mobs hold, boxing you in.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.circleSp: How fast waiting mobs take their place in the ring, times their chase speed.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.packSurg: Waiting mobs that rush in together every 5 to 10 s, on top of the attackers. 0 is off.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.attacker: Least ticks between two mobs starting a wind-up at you. 0 is off.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.spareMou: Your swings never hit the mob you are riding.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.spareBys: Sweeps skip your pets and calm mobs; an aimed hit still lands.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.waitersF: A waiting mob still attacks when you come within its reach.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.mobVsMob: Mobs wind up and tell their attacks at other mobs too, not only at players.
Blocks from a player within which mob fights wind up. 0 is everywhere.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.modAttac: A modded mob's own attack animation plays as its wind-up's tell.
vectorcombat.configuration.mobs.spawnShi: Some melee humanoids spawn with a shield (15%, by the mob_shields data).
